min_clearance.basis: JLCPCB multilayer 1 oz minimum trace spacing 0.09 mm and BGA pad-to-track 0.09 mm; the earlier 0.15 mm was an agent-chosen margin (advisory) and blocked any BGA escape at 0.5 mm pitch

min_track_width.basis: JLCPCB multilayer 1 oz minimum trace 0.09 mm (3 mil acceptable in BGA fan-outs); general nets keep the 0.20 mm Default net class

min_through_hole_diameter.basis: JLCPCB min 0.15 mm; 0.2-0.25 mm holes under 0.45 mm via diameter cost extra; 0.30 mm is standard cost

min_via_diameter.basis: JLCPCB published minimum via 0.25 mm diameter on a 0.15 mm hole (0.05 mm ring); 0.30 mm drill is standard cost; 0.50 mm gives a 0.10 mm ring, twice the published via minimum. The Default net class via stays 0.60/0.30 (0.15 mm ring)

min_via_annular_width.basis: JLCPCB via 0.15/0.25 implies a 0.05 mm via ring; 0.10 mm doubles it. The PTH annular-ring figures (recommended 0.20 mm, absolute 0.15 mm multilayer) apply to component through-holes and are met by every PTH pad on the board

min_hole_to_hole.basis: JLCPCB via hole-to-hole 0.20 mm; component PTH pad hole-to-hole 0.45 mm must be checked separately where PTH pads are adjacent

min_hole_clearance.basis: JLCPCB via hole to track 0.20 mm; PTH to track 0.28 mm (0.35 mm recommended) applies to component holes

min_copper_edge_clearance.basis: JLCPCB copper to routed edge 0.20 mm (0.40 mm at V-cut; no V-cut on this board)

solder_mask_min_width.basis: JLCPCB solder mask bridge 0.10 mm pad spacing at 1 oz (green); not a KiCad board-setup field, applied in mask settings

telemetry-pod.kicad_dru.basis: RF 50-ohm width from the retained stackup calculation (unchanged, inherited)

telemetry-pod.kicad_dru.rule: intra-footprint pad clearance 0.15 mm for U2, U16, U17, U18, U19
telemetry-pod.kicad_dru.basis: ST LSM6DSO32 land pattern p.149 Fig. 22 with TN0018 Rev 8 section 3.7; TI DSE0006A drawing 4220552/B p.25; within JLCPCB 0.15 mm pad-to-pad

thermal_vias.basis: Same-net heatsink vias under exposed pads: 0.30 mm drill is standard cost (JLCPCB charges extra for 0.20/0.25 mm holes under 0.45 mm via diameter); 0.70 mm diameter gives a 0.20 mm ring for thermal copper, a deliberate choice above the 0.10 mm via minimum. The original 0.20/0.40 mm vias were within JLCPCB via capability but carried the small-hole surcharge and violated the project's 0.30 mm hole minimum

owner_authorization: 2026-10-20: relax the clearance rules if you must, as long as JLCPCB can manufacture it, and it doesn't affect electrical performance.

layer_stack.stackup: JLC04161H-7628: F.Cu 0.035, prepreg 0.2104, In1.Cu 0.0152, core 1.065, In2.Cu 0.0152, prepreg 0.2104, B.Cu 0.035 (mm), epsilon_r 4.5
layer_stack.basis: D-PCB-2: U14 FEMDME008G eMMC is a 153-ball 0.5 mm BGA whose fanout needs inner layers; LMR36520 SNVSBF0C section 8.5.1 item 5 asks for a ground plane in a middle layer; GNSS RF_50 needs a defined reference; JLCPCB 4-layer is standard cost. The scaffold-generated stackup matches JLCPCB's published 4-layer 1.6 mm stackup, so it is adopted as a cited value, not a default. The owner's 'double-sided' target refers to component sides, not copper layer count.

open_items.D-PCB-3 eMMC interior fanout: U14 FEMDME008G (BGA-153, 0.5 mm pitch, 0.24 mm pads) has 10 connected interior balls (EMMC_VCC_3V3 x4, GND x5, EMMC_DS at H5). A 0.60 mm via does not fit a dogbone between 0.5 mm balls (0.467 mm pad-edge diagonal gap). Candidate answers, to be decided by a bounded routing experiment: a BGA net class with JLCPCB's published BGA allowances (0.09 mm pad-to-track, 0.10 mm track, 0.25/0.15 mm via, surcharge) or via-in-pad with filled vias (JLCPCB lists filled and capped vias as default for 6 layers and above; availability as a 4-layer option must be confirmed on the order form). The first KRT diagnostic left all eMMC bus nets unrouted. Analysis 2026-10-20 (agent-499): of the ten interior balls, nine are GND (E7, G5, H10, J5, K8) and EMMC_VCC_3V3 (E6, F5, J10, K9), reachable by B.Cu (ball-side) pours under U14 without any via; the only interior signal is EMMC_DS at H5, which connects solely to pull-down R55 (10 k). The ESP32-S3 SD/MMC host has no HS400 mode, so DS is unused; if the FEMDME008G datasheet permits an unused DS to be left open or terminated at the device, the schematic can drop or relocate R55 and no interior dogbone via is needed at all. The perimeter signals (CLK, CMD, DAT0-7, VDDi at C2) escape on the surface. Leading answer: B.Cu GND/VCC pours under U14 plus a storage-stage schematic decision on DS; no via-in-pad and no BGA net class unless the DS decision fails. DECISION v2 (2026-10-21, experiment pending): U14 LFBGA-153 ball pads reduced from 0.24 to 0.22 mm NSMD (within IPC-7351 for 0.30 mm balls at 0.5 mm pitch; the FEMDME008G datasheet gives no land pattern, package per JEDEC MO-276 11.5x13 mm); net class BGA_EMMC 0.09/0.09 mm for the EMMC_* nets; board-setup clearance and track floors set to JLCPCB's 0.09 mm; B.Cu pours for GND and EMMC_VCC_3V3 under U14 with 0.09 mm clearance and 0.09 mm minimum width (solid connection). Geometry: 0.5 pitch - 0.22 pad = 0.28 mm between pad edges; a 0.09 mm track with 0.095 mm to each pad meets the 0.09 floor; a 0.10 mm pour web between balls meets the 0.09 minimum width. If the routing experiment cannot connect the interior GND/VCC balls this way, the next options are filled via-in-pad (JLCPCB option, cost) or leaving DS/unused balls open per datasheet; those are owner-visible decisions recorded here. EXPERIMENT RESULT (2026-10-21, kicad-route run --nets '/EMMC_*' on the planed iteration-3 board with D-PCB-3 v2 + D-PCB-6/7, receipts in routing-diagnostic/iteration-3/bga-exp/bga-emmc-only): routing COMPLETE for all EMMC_* nets, 126 tracks, 10 vias, 0 new DRC violations; the perimeter-row escape and the interior EMMC_VCC_3V3 balls work. The B.Cu GND pour under U14 fragmented (1.1 mm2 left, 11 polygons, isolated islands), so the five interior GND balls (E7, G5, H10, J5, K8) cannot be reached by a pour between 0.22 mm balls. Remaining spec-compliant answer for those five: filled and capped via-in-pad (JLCPCB option; cost; via 0.15 mm hole / 0.25 mm diameter inside a 0.25 mm pad), which is an owner cost decision; the alternative of leaving VSS balls open is not spec-compliant (JEDEC eMMC requires all VSS connected) and is not recommended. The GND pour under U14 is withdrawn from the plan; the EMMC_VCC_3V3 pour stays.

decisions_pending_next_seed.D-PCB-4 J2 anchor: Molex 73251-1150 edge-launch SMA (captured footprint 73251-1153 family, SHA 318c8b54...). The footprint's F.Fab edge datum is 0.50 mm outboard of its pad copper. At the historical anchor x=85.44 (rotation 180) the datum lands at x=90.20, 0.20 mm outside the board edge, and the pads at 89.70 (0.30 mm clearance, 5 copper_edge findings). Decision: move the J2 anchor to x=85.24 so the datum coincides with the edge (x=90.00) and the pads sit at 0.50 mm. Evidence: agent-491 J2 geometry review (~/.cache/agent491-sma-mechanical-review). Apply at the next seed; the manufacturer drawing SD-73251-115 B3 could not be downloaded and must still be inspected for launch geometry.
decisions_pending_next_seed.D-PCB-5 plane plan: agent-ee.plane-plan/1 with In1.Cu = GND over the board outline and In2.Cu = +3V3 over the board outline (largest rail, the MCU/IMU/ADC logic supply); thermal reliefs 0.3/0.3, clearance 0.25, min width 0.20, island removal always. Basis: LMR36520 §8.5.1 item 5 (ground plane in a middle layer), RF_50 reference for the GNSS line, JLC04161H-7628 stack. PRE_6V3, POD_12V_PROTECTED and the sensor rails are routed as tracks sized by net class. Recorded in planes.json; applied by kicad-route planes before the routing campaign.
decisions_pending_next_seed.D-PCB-6 RF reference keep-out: Under the GNSS line from the U3 RF pad (77.5, 29.1) to the J2 pin (86.96, 28.0), keep In1.Cu (GND plane) unbroken and keep tracks and vias off In1.Cu and In2.Cu in x 76..88, y 26.5..30.6 mm: a native rule area (no tracks, no vias, layers In1.Cu and In2.Cu) added to the board before routing. Basis: 50-ohm microstrip referenced to the In1 plane (RF_50 net class), reviewer condition on iteration 3. Applied at the next routing pass of iteration 3.
decisions_pending_next_seed.D-PCB-7 plane layers carry no tracks: In1.Cu (GND) and In2.Cu (+3V3) are plane layers: native rule areas over the board outline with no-tracks on both layers (vias allowed, so fan-out and layer changes still pass through). Basis: the planed iteration-3 route placed signal tracks on In1.Cu (blocked-by top entries TIRE_CAN_TX_ENABLE, TWAI_RX, MCU_BOOT46, TWAI_TX on In1.Cu), which cuts the GND reference the RF_50 line and the bucks depend on (LMR36520 SNVSBF0C §8.5.1 item 5). Signal routing is F.Cu and B.Cu only; if two signal layers prove insufficient, the owner decision is a 6-layer stack, not tracks in the planes. Applied with D-PCB-6 before the next routing pass.
